name: Neuron Activation
core: A monkey's brain lights up at a stimulus, used for something that instantly excites or triggers you.
avoid: Not for boring or neutral things.

name: No Maidens
core: Megamind staring smugly asking 'No ___?' to mock someone for lacking something.
avoid: Not for kind or supportive messages.

name: Communist Cat
core: A cat before a Soviet flag, used to declare something 'ours' in the shared-everything communist joke.
avoid: Not for serious political arguments.

name: Homer Simpson Mmm
core: Homer drooling 'Mmm...' over something he craves.
avoid: Not for things you find disgusting.

name: Officer Cartman
core: Cartman as a cop demanding respect for his authority over something petty.
avoid: Not for real police or legal matters.

name: Advice God
core: God explaining a petty or trolling design choice in creation.
avoid: Not for mocking anyone's sincere faith.

name: Rafiki Holding Up Simba
core: Rafiki proudly presenting baby Simba, used for proudly showing off something to the world.
avoid: Not for embarrassing things you'd hide.

name: Research Cat
core: A bespectacled cat at a laptop, used for someone earnestly looking something up or researching an absurd question.
avoid: Not for real expertise or serious academic topics.

name: Those Who Know
core: Mr. Incredible goes from cheerful to haunted, used for a thing that only people with grim insider experience truly understand.
avoid: Not for ordinary good-or-bad comparisons with many stages.

name: Pressing Both Buttons
core: Instead of agonizing between two options, the guy smugly presses both, used for choosing everything at once.
avoid: Not for genuine painful dilemmas where only one choice is possible.

name: Master Oogway
core: The wise old turtle delivers a profound-sounding quote, used for fake wisdom about a mundane or silly truth.
avoid: Not for genuinely serious life advice.

name: Kid Named
core: Mike Ehrmantraut stares deadpan under a 'Kid named ___:' caption, joking that someone or something is literally named after its defining trait.
avoid: Not for long setups; the joke is one short label.

name: Trailer Park Boys Bubbles
core: Bubbles looks stunned and indignant, used to react to something outrageous or baffling.
avoid: Not for calm or happy reactions.

name: Goku Staring

avoid: Not for cheerful or excited reactions.

name: Elitist Victorian Scumbag

avoid: Not for genuine admiration or warmth.

name: Age of Men
core: The orc Gothmog declares 'the age of men is over, the time of the orc has come', used to announce one thing being replaced by something worse.
slots: the age of [old thing] is over
the time of [new thing] has come
aliases: the age of men is over
avoid: Not for welcome or positive change.

name: Angry Koala

name: Efrain Juarez

avoid: Not for calm or bored reactions.

name: Surprised Vegeta
